_comment: Overlay for the catalog-scope decision (Bei, 2026-11-24): tool/data APIs and aggregators are collected, LLM APIs are set aside (hidden by default, not deleted). Read by scripts/build_apis.py. vendor_overrides/aggregator_overrides keys are the external index's own slug/id; unknown fields are null.

openrouter.visibility_note: LLM router aggregator; set aside with LLM APIs 2026-11-24, restorable.

extra_aggregators.name: treg
extra_aggregators.what_it_is: A third-party intermediary that resells per-call access to many third-party tool and data APIs through its own token and base URL, billed from a prepaid balance. SkeletonKey lists it as a catalog entry, not as a recommended access layer: hold your own vendor accounts and keys where you can, rather than routing everything through one gateway key.
extra_aggregators.billing_model: Metered per call from a prepaid balance, at cost with 0% markup stated; a new verified account gets a one-time free credit of $1.00. treg publishes no single per-call price across its catalog.
extra_aggregators.fee_or_markup_policy: States 0% markup: calls are billed "at cost" from the prepaid balance (treg's own skill.md, read 2026-10-28).
extra_aggregators.provider_count_claimed: 4,000+ tools across 119 providers (treg.to/catalog: "4,064 endpoints across 113 platforms and 119 providers", read 2026-10-28)
